"""Main: commit closed official full32K and new integration admission evidence."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
D = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/docs-sycl-storage-retention-20261009')
W = D.parent / 'sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012'
F = D / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-latest-updates-pristine-builds-host-regression'
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('official_long_boundary_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')

def identity(p):
    return dict(path=str(p), sha256=m.sha(p), bytes=p.stat().st_size)

def compact(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        result = {}
        for key, item in value.items():
            if any(word in key.lower() for word in ('token', 'api')) and isinstance(item,str) and len(item)==64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in item):
                result[key] = {'sha256':item}
            elif key == 'token_logprob_sha256':
                result['token_logprob_identity'] = {'sha256':item}
            elif key in ('evidence','command_evidence') and isinstance(item,dict) and all(isinstance(fields,dict) and all(isinstance(text,str) for text in fields.values()) for fields in item.values()):
                result[key] = {label:{channel:dict(bytes=len(text.encode()), sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    content=text if len(text.encode()) <= 16384 else text[:8192]+'\n[compact middle omitted]\n'+text[-4096:])
                    for channel,text in fields.items()} for label,fields in item.items()}
            else:
                result[key] = compact(item)
        return result
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [compact(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and len(value.encode()) > 32768:
        return dict(bytes=len(value.encode()), sha256=hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    head=value[:8192], tail=value[-4096:], scope='Compact derivative; exact original remains pinned for current admission consumer')
    return value


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'latest-update-main-cache-startup-retention-boundary-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], artifacts=[],
             source=identity(Path(__file__)), gpu_executed=False)
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    staged = out / 'staged'
    staged.mkdir()
    prepared = []
    start = time.monotonic()
    def write(relative, value):
        p = staged / relative
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        raw = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'
        assert len(raw.encode()) < 1 << 20
        p.write_text(raw)
        prepared.append((p, F / relative))
    def run(label, argv, cwd=D):
        left = 600 - (time.monotonic() - start)
        assert left > 0
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, cwd, wall=min(120, left), cpu=480,
            rss_cap=8 << 30, text_cap=64 << 20, file_cap=64 << 20, total_cap=96 << 20)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label
        return so.read_text().strip()
    try:
        assert not run('status-before', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        assert run('branch', ['/usr/bin/git', 'branch', '--show-current']) == 'docs/sycl-storage-retention-2026-10-09'
        assert run('origin', ['/usr/bin/git', 'remote', 'get-url', 'origin']) == 'git@github.com:yqYo1/Strata.git'
        assert all(line.startswith('file:/home/yayoi/.config/git/config') for line in
            run('identity', ['/usr/bin/git', 'config', '--show-origin', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$']).splitlines())
        remote = {}
        for label, url, expected in (('official', 'https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata.git',
                                     '7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d'),
                                    ('xestrata', 'https://github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata.git',
                                     'da3d426079019daa6e01388d03b0d94ae67070b7')):
            text = run('remote-' + label, ['/usr/bin/git', 'ls-remote', url, 'HEAD'])
            assert len(text.splitlines()) == 1 and text.split()[1] == 'HEAD'
            head = text.split()[0]
            remote[label] = dict(url=url, head=head, measured_revision=expected, unchanged=head == expected)
        for name in ('latest-update-main-integrated-results-boundary-root-v2',
                     'latest-update-main-provider-health-official-startup-root-v10',
                     'latest-update-main-cache512-startup-health-root-v1',
                     'latest-update-pristine-official-cache512-model-root-v1/official-startup'):
            p = B / name / 'record.json'
            v = json.loads(p.read_text())
            assert v['passed'] and v['complete'] and not v['active']
            assert all(c['direct_child_reaped'] and c['session_empty'] and c['session_anchored'] and
                c['exit_code'] == 0 and not c['cleanup'] and not c['survivors'] for c in v.get('commands', []) + v.get('guard_commands', []))
            write('receipts-v159/' + name.replace('/', '--') + '.json', dict(original=identity(p), derivative=True,
                original_status_preserved=True, receipt=compact(v)))
        startup = B / 'latest-update-pristine-official-cache512-model-root-v1/official-startup/record.json'
        value = json.loads(startup.read_text())
        raw = startup.parent / 'commands/engine.stderr'
        lines = [line for line in raw.read_text().splitlines() if any(word in line for word in
            ('PER-LAYER', 'per-layer slots', 'pre-filled', 'ranked pairs', 'expert cache ', 'free after the expert cache'))]
        assert value['effective_info']['expert_slots'] == '624' and any('pre-filled 624 of 624' in line for line in lines)
        retention = B / 'latest-update-main-closed-update-retention-v1.json'
        deleted = json.loads(retention.read_text())
        assert deleted['passed'] and not deleted['active']
        assert all(not Path(p).exists() for p in deleted['deleted'])
        assert all(m.sha(p) == digest for p, digest in deleted['immutable_receipts'].items())
        write('closed-update-deletion-manifest-v159.json', deleted)
        write('official-cache512-startup-v159.json', dict(main_reviewed=True, source_revision='7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d',
            binary=value['binary'], argv=value['argv'], environment=value['environment'],
            startup_receipt=identity(startup), observed_startup_seconds=value['startup_wall_seconds_observed'],
            effective_info=value['effective_info'], actual_cache_lines=lines, normal_quit=True, fault_observed=False,
            effective_slots=624, per_layer_quota=13, requested_single_block_bytes=1276953600,
            pair_uniqueness='Full profile reviewed: all24576 pairs unique. With successful full per-layer fill,624 unique resident pairs selected.',
            readback_scope='First ranked profile pair assigned slot, not physical slot0/all-slot readback',
            model32k_executed=False, performance_claim=False,
            hardware_properties=dict(max_alloc_levelzero=10132807680,max_alloc_sycl=10132807680,
                global_memory=10666115072,usm_atomic_host_allocations=False,usm_atomic_shared_allocations=False),
            remote_heads_rechecked=remote, next='Source eligibility review for measured unsupported USM atomics, then actual pristine32K cache512 request. Auto/workers tuning and full262144 remain open.'))
        for p in (B / 'latest-update-main-closed-update-retention-v1.py', Path(__file__)):
            write('controller-sources-v159/' + p.name + '.json', dict(identity=identity(p), content=p.read_text()))
        leak = out / 'secret-scan.json'
        run('private-secret-scan', [str(L / 'bin/gitleaks'), 'dir', str(staged), '--no-banner', '--redact',
                                  '--report-format', 'json', '--report-path', str(leak)])
        assert json.loads(leak.read_text()) == []
        run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', str(W / 'tools/lint/run.sh'), *[str(p) for p, _ in prepared]], cwd=W)
        for p, target in prepared:
            assert not target.exists()
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
            r['artifacts'].append(identity(target))
        run('whole-secret-scan', [str(L / 'bin/gitleaks'), 'dir', str(F), '--no-banner', '--redact'])
        run('stage', ['/usr/bin/git', 'add', '--', *[str(p.relative_to(D)) for _, p in prepared]])
        run('check', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'])
        run('commit', ['/usr/bin/git', 'commit', '-m', 'docs(sycl): qualify official cache capacity and retire closed logs'])
        r['revision'] = run('head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['/usr/bin/git', 'push', 'origin', 'HEAD'])
        assert not run('status-after', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain'])
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        import traceback
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'revision')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
